title: Not sturdy
text: Not sturdy. The top of the soap dispenser is plastic, and not even good quality plastic. It’s super flimsy and the nozzle wobbles all around every time you push down for soap. The base is lovely, heavier glass with a beautiful gray smoky quality to it. I probably use this if I switched the top out to a better quality pump.
